why: The classifier matched prose keywords against registry records that carry only structural facts. SPARE-F001 declares app_families DIAL_WEB and code_paths apps/preview-player/app/garage/page.tsx - unmistakably a web UI feature - but the record contains the word 'react' or 'next' nowhere, so WEB_UI_IMPLEMENTATION could never fire. Across all 309 features only 13 of the 62 task classes resources declare were ever emitted, which stranded the entire curated reference corpus at the graph-projection layer. These signals classify from facts the records actually carry.
precedence: Structural signals are additive to the existing prose rules; they never remove a class a prose rule matched. A free-text instruction still classifies as it always did.

surface_signal_requires_code_evidence._comment: Every surface signal now requires code corroboration. WHATSAPP fired on SPARE-F004 - a backend catalogue package - purely because app_families listed it.

path_signals._comment: Matched against feature.code_paths and contract code references. Ordered; all matches apply.

rules.why: A .tsx file is a React component by definition.
App-router directory in the customer web app.

test_path_signals._comment: Matched against feature.test_paths and capability test_paths.

contract_signals._comment: Empty by measurement: security_profile, events and api_contract are each present on 309/309 features, so none of them discriminates.

module_signals._comment: From feature.module. Domain classes, not implementation classes.

blob_stringify_note: Previously the whole feature record was JSON-stringified into the classifier text, so any literal appearing anywhere in the record fired its rule. That is how a backend catalogue package classified as WHATSAPP. Typed field extraction replaces it.

calibration.measured_on: 2026-09-12 over all 309 features, after contract surfaces stopped entering the prose classifier
calibration.rule: A signal firing on more than max_feature_fraction of features carries no information and is rejected by agent:vekl:signal-calibration.

rejected_signals.signal: contract.surfaces joined into the prose classifier text
rejected_signals.verdict: exposure declarations bypassed the corroboration requirement; surfaces now reach the classifier only through the structural path

calibration.exempt_why: GENERAL_DEVELOPMENT is the no-signal sentinel. A high rate means the records carry little the rules can read - a fact about the registry, not a bad rule.

prose_signals._comment: Registry-owned prose rules for task classes the code-resident rule tables never emitted. Measured 2026-09-12: resources declared 62 task classes; the classifier could emit only 37 of them, so 25 declared classes - 86 resource declarations including RELIABILITY (22), SECURITY (20) and AI_SECURITY (17) - were dead vocabulary. A resource whose only declared class is unreachable can never be retrieved, and under graph-first bounding unreachable means unretrievable. agent:vekl:task-class-coherence now fails the build if the two vocabularies drift apart again.
prose_signals.applies_to: instruction, affected paths, feature.outcome, feature.implementation_note, contract.archetype

rules.pattern: \b(prompt injection|jailbreak|llm security|ai security|model abuse|agent security|tool[- ]use safety|untrusted (model|llm) output)\b
\b(edge security|waf|web application firewall|bot protection|edge rate limit\w*|cloudflare (security|access))\b
